design.purpose: A warm two-colour striped scarf for one adult, worked in chunky single crochet with the photographed green and blue yarn and 15 mm hook. Check that each skein contains enough yarn before starting; add a matching third skein if either colour runs short.

steps.c: Place the green yarn ready to work from.
Ch 17 with green yarn and 15 mm hook.
Row 1: sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch, 16 sc.
Rows 2–15: ch 1, turn, 16 sc in green.
Rows 16–30: ch 1, turn, 16 sc in green.
Cut green yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Place the blue yarn ready to join.
Join blue in last stitch; rows 31–45: 16 sc.
Rows 46–60: ch 1, turn, 16 sc in blue; fasten off.
Cut blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Weave all tails in with the yarn needle.
